Il lessico BI-RADS per l'ecografia descr:
The BI-RADS ultrasound lexicon describes a mass with a few words: shape (oval, round, irregular), orientation (parallel to the skin = wider than tall; not parallel = taller than wide), margins (circumscribed, or indistinct, angular, microlobulated, spiculated), echo pattern (anechoic, hypoechoic, complex…) and posterior features (enhancement, shadowing, none).
Invasive lobular carcinoma grows as single files of cells infiltrating between structures without forming a discrete mass. This is why on mammography it is often subtle (only a distortion) and on ultrasound it appears as an irregular hypoechoic area with shadowing, sometimes underestimated.
It is more often multifocal and bilateral: after diagnosis breast MRI is useful for local staging.
BI-RADS 4 is divided into 4A (2-10%), 4B (10-50%) and 4C (50-95%); in all cases the recommendation is biopsy.
Margini angolati e ombra bastano per il: Angular margins and shadowing are enough for BI-RADS 4: biopsy.
Collezione BUS-BRA: BI-RADS 4, istologia: BUS-BRA collection: BI-RADS 4, histology invasive lobular carcinoma (malignant).
